coordinate_convention: Zero-based [left,top,right,bottom] half-open pixels. Boxes are exact reproducible closeup regions, not surgical tracing polygons. Source boxes refer to original full-resolution source; candidate boxes to shipped WebP; rendered boxes to exported paper1800.
scope: Six assigned birds; no asset or provenance edits. Analysis crops only. Software inspection, no physical-panel test.

findings.title: Inner rear toe/claw removed; outer hook detached
findings.finding: Immediately below the long forward toe, the original has a curled rear toe/claw adjoining the twig. The current hole removes its inner painted material and connection, leaving a separate curved sliver in the stock paper renderer. Restore the source toe/claw and its original relation to the twig; do not invent a connection.

findings.title: Some original facial bristles clipped
findings.finding: The fine original bristles ahead of the forehead/bill join and along the underside of the bill are partly excluded by the smoothed contour. Small detail at final scale; secondary to the foot correction.

findings.title: Inner curved claw removed by angular hole
findings.finding: The smaller dark curved claw directly beside the right edge of the twig is present in the original and mostly removed by the current interior polygon. The same hole leaves sharp notches through the twig/claw junction. This remains plainly angular and missing in stock paper1800. Some green botanical pixels also remain beneath the sloping toe; preserve actual claw strokes while removing only the background.

findings.title: Pale tail-feather tips chopped off
findings.finding: Multiple pale terminal feather tips, visibly bounded by original feather strokes, are cut off into angular steps. They are genuine plumage, not blank paper. The stock renderer shows shortened dark stepped ends; restore the complete original pale tips using source alpha.

findings.title: Tongue-tip fringe and lower-bill bristles shortened
findings.finding: The fine divided tongue tip is simplified to a point and some lower-bill bristles are cropped by the current smooth contour. These are smaller source-detail losses than the foot and tail defects.

findings.title: Possible lower rear claw omitted
findings.finding: At the lower-left side of the twig, the original appears to contain a dark pointed toe/claw extension below the prominent loop. The current mask removes it and leaves the twig bare there. Foot overlaps a gray leaf in the source, so this requires independent anatomy/source confirmation before editing; this bird is not cleared as a pass.

findings.title: Chin feather fringe clipped
findings.finding: Fine dark feather tips immediately below the bill/white chin are removed by a smooth, relatively high contour. The broad head/bill anatomy is intact; this is a small source-detail restoration opportunity.

findings.title: Smaller hooked claw strokes removed
findings.finding: Between the twig and the large forward claw, the source has smaller hooked toe/claw strokes. The polygon hole removes these completely. The stock paper renderer shows an empty triangular gap and only one large claw, unlike the original. Restore the original dark anatomy while separating green leaf background.

findings.title: Outer tail-tip contour slightly squared
findings.finding: The pale terminal tips are mostly retained, but the uppermost tiny tip and several rounded end contours are clipped to angular edges. Visible in enlarged source comparison; lower severity than the missing toe/claw strokes.
